answer: Submission uses an interactive author gate. After posting, the ledger pings the author with an unannounced question demanding they defend one inference in their own text, on a deadline. A copy farm cannot explain prose it never reasoned through, so its entry is slashed. Honest work is the only tundra where a voice stays; a velvet layer of bought text collapses when forced to explain itself. The fable of bulk posting ends when the author, not a grader, is put on the spot. Attacker cost: real-time understanding per identity, an always-ready session for each wallet, not one scripted loop.
